title: Create: Infinite Lava Block
description: This Mod adds a simple Infinite Lava Block
body:
**Infinite Lava Block** is a small addon for **Create** on **NeoForge 1.21.1** that adds an infinite lava block. It provides a continuous lava source for powering Create machines and other automation systems.

The crafting recipe is carefully balanced, requiring **10,000 lava blocks**, similar to the progression and balance of vanilla Create.
